name: Archive Master – Archive Content & Auto Archive Orders for WooCommerce
author: WPPOOL

sections.description:
Homepage | Documentation | Tutorials | Live Demo

Optimize your WooCommerce store and store old data in a remote database with the ideal order archive plugin for WordPress. With ArchiveMaster, easily archive old orders, export order data, and streamline database performance. Managing order history is no longer a hassle!

[Video of How to use this Plugin]

Why Do You Need Archive Master?

Old WooCommerce orders take up a lot of space in your database over time, consuming valuable storage and impacting performance. Each time WooCommerce runs its functions, it also processes these older, less-relevant order records, increasing query load and slowing down your site.

With Archive Master, optimize your store’s backend by seamlessly archiving old orders. Simply configure a dedicated database for archived data, connect it to Archive Master, and set your preferred time frame for archiving. Archive Master takes care of the rest, ensuring that only active, necessary orders remain in your primary database. 🚀

Upgrade to smarter order management. Archive Master maintains a smart, high-performance WooCommerce store by efficiently offloading old order data. Keep your site fast, your database efficient, and your customers satisfied.

Old WooCommerce orders take up a lot of space in your database. And every time WooCommerce’s functionalities are loading, the order queries also load, making your site performance slower.

Archive Master Plugin Helps You Achieve:

  • Optimized Database Performance: Archiving old orders keeps your WooCommerce database optimized, improving store speed and user experience.
  • Store Old Data Securely: Move your old data to a remote database and access them anytime you want without ever needing to worry about data lose.
  • Efficient Data Management: Move outdated orders to a separate database, making organizing and accessing essential data easier.
  • Improved Store Speed: A lightweight database reduces load times, ensuring a faster, more responsive shopping experience for your customers.
  • Reduced Storage Costs: Free up space by archiving old orders, lowering storage expenses, and streamlining database maintenance.
  • Easily Configurable Settings: Set custom time frames for order archiving and manage storage locations with ease.

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get the Premium Version

🔝 Archive Master Free Features

  • 🗃️ Archive Old Orders: Archive WooCommerce orders from any chosen date range (e.g., 7 days, 15 days, 1 month, etc). Orders are securely transferred to a remote database like Amazon RDS, enhancing your store’s speed and performance.

  • 🔙 Restore Archived Orders: Want to restore specific order data that’s been archived? You can restore archived orders at any time from the connected database.

  • 📦 Manage Old Orders: View and manage archived orders anytime from WooCommerce, with easy one-click restoration to keep your store organized and efficient!

  • 📥 Export WooCommerce Orders: Export WooCommerce orders in CSV, JSON, XML, and PDF for easy backup. Simply go to the plugin’s download option to save all or selected orders!

  • 🔜 Expanded Archive Database Support (Upcoming): Currently Archive Master supports Amazon RDS for archiving orders on a remote server. More remote database options for archiving, including Google Cloud SQL, Microsoft Azure, Custom MySQL databases, and A2 Hosting.

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get the Premium Version

👑 ArchiveMaster Pro Features

🔄 Auto-Archive Orders: Set automated schedules for archiving old orders with the plugin’s auto-archive option, keeping your WooCommerce database clean and optimized effortlessly!

⚡️ No Restriction on Orders Range: You can archive any old orders without any restrictions!

📆 Custom Date Selection for Archiving Orders: You can select a custom date and orders upto that date will be archived to the remote database.

🗄️ Content Archiving (Upcoming): Easily archive WordPress Media, WooCommerce Products, Posts, and Custom Post Types to keep your site organized and optimized. Perfect for managing large content libraries and enhancing site performance.

✨ Try Live Demo | ⚡ Get the Premium Version

Privacy Policy

Archive Master uses Appsero SDK to collect some telemetry data upon user’s confirmation. This helps us to troubleshoot problems faster & make product improvements.

Appsero SDK does not gather any data by default. The SDK only starts gathering basic telemetry data when a user allows it via the admin notice. We collect the data to ensure a great user experience for all our users.

Integrating Appsero SDK DOES NOT IMMEDIATELY start gathering data, without confirmation from users in any case.

Learn more about how Appsero collects and uses this data.
sections.installation:
1. Navigate to WordPress Dashboard > Plugins > Add New. Search for “Archive Master” and activate the plugin.
  2. Access the plugin from the left sidebar of the WordPress dashboard.
  3. Ensure you have an external database configured.
  4. In the Archive Master interface, easily manage your past orders by archiving old orders for better organization or exporting them as a file for backup

Learn more about how Archive Master works through our overview video.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OIo2qbVsM6U]
sections.faq:
Do I need to know any programming language for using this plugin?

No coding knowledge is required for using this plugin.

How do I archive my old orders data from my store database?

The easiest way to archive old orders data from your store database is through the Archive Master plugin. Install and activate the plugin, configure the database and reduce load from your store.

Where do I contact for support?

Please use the official WordPress support forum to report your issues.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0 – 29 Jan 2025

  • Initial Release
  • New: Archive your old orders to Amazon RDS remote database and optimize your site speed
  • New: You can select a date range and archive the orders within that range to the remote database
  • New: Set a schedule and your orders will automatically be archived in the remote database
  • New: You can export all of your orders into different formats such as: CSV, XML, JSON
